definition.note: No closed form is stored: the surface is not implemented in math_art, so there is no shipped code to verify a transcription against, and an unverified formula from the literature would be worse than a null. See construction.blocked_by.

symmetry.continuous: SO(2) about the axis; periodic along it

construction.blocked_by: The family record. Its MEMBERS ship (mesh.delaunay_surface_add), so the family itself has no row of its own.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: C. Delaunay, 'Sur la surface de revolution dont la courbure moyenne est constante', J. Math. Pures Appl. 6 (1841).

caveats: Delaunay's theorem: the surfaces of revolution of constant mean curvature are exactly the plane, sphere, cylinder, catenoid, unduloid and nodoid -- and their profiles are the ROULETTES of the conics, which is why the family is one object.
